hypotheses.justification: This follows from hpol and u's existing properties. Spec k has one point, so hpol gives σ* u.pol ≅ u.pol globally. The definitions give a very ample invertible sheaf on the smooth, proper, connected scheme u.A, which is integral. Preservation of this sheaf makes σ finite: a positive-dimensional fibre would carry a trivial very ample sheaf, which is impossible. A finite self-map of this integral variety is surjective. Pullback therefore acts injectively, hence bijectively, on the finite-dimensional space H⁰(u.pol). In the complete-linear-system embedding, σ is consequently induced by a projective linear automorphism, so it is a closed immersion. Since u.A is reduced and σ is surjective, `isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective` gives IsIso σ.1. Supply this derived fact to the existing proof instead of hσiso. This argument also covers dimension zero; emptiness is excluded by the section u.L.one (𝟙 _), and no positivity assumptions on g, d, or n are needed.
